title: W2F client -> server command (protocol 1)

first.description: an item id in the item bag (a base component)

second.description: another base component in the bag (the same id twice needs two copies)

oneOf.description: combine two components of the bag into the finished item (recipes in items.json); answered with `result`, then a `bag_event` and the new `state`

oneOf.description: (revision 3) lock or unlock the shop: a locked shop keeps its current offer through the next round's automatic refresh (rerolling and buying still work). Answered with `result` and the new `state`
(revision 5) answer the pending trait choice: an option index, or -1 to decline a prototype

oneOf.description: Revision 7, queue server only: look for a match. bots = you + AI players at once; normal = wait for other players (AI players fill the empty seats after the server's fill time). Revision 8: ranked = like normal, and the result moves your rank (needs accounts). Revision 9: ready_check.
